# AI Radar

AI Radar is a Vietnamese-first AI production intelligence publication for creators, builders, and AI production teams.

## Core content
- /vi/today
- /vi/ai-video
- /vi/ai-image
- /vi/ai-agentic
- /vi/ai-vibe-coding
- /vi/prompts
- /en/today

## Agent-ready exports
- /data/agent/articles.vi.jsonl
- /data/agent/articles.en.jsonl
- /data/agent/chunks.vi.jsonl
- /data/agent/chunks.en.jsonl
- /data/agent/source-notes.jsonl
- /data/agent/topic-clusters.jsonl
- /data/agent/prompt-workflows.jsonl
- /data/agent/training-manifest.json
